fretec.text: Fretec is a study in patience: matchup rating among the very best, bravery and resistance both at the very top, and a matchup kill-death line up near the top. The pace is measured, the headshot share thin, and the lifetime IvI down near the very bottom, yet the matchups sit at the top. The edge holds firm against the hardest third too, which is the mark of a player who saves their best for the hardest fights.

fatdobber.text: Fatdobber is a young account already fighting at the top: among the very best tracked across every count, with a furious tempo and the surest aim around. The output climbs with the opposition. The toughest-third hold stays high. Early read, but the first pages are hard to argue with.

friendlytester.text: Since 2014, FriendlyTester has been the definition of reliable: near the summit of everyone tracked, constant against any opposition. The hardest opposition never rattles them. The lifetime numbers line up with the matchups, which keeps the story clean. A veteran who shows up, holds the line, and makes every fight a little harder than expected.

funnycjack.text: FUNNYCJACK never lets the fight slow down: among the fastest killers in the game, in the upper reaches of everyone tracked, and unrelenting whatever the fight demands. The accuracy and headshots sit near the top too, which rounds out a complete card. A whirlwind who turns every exchange into a race the other side loses.

fantom220tr.text: Fantom220TR has been at this since 2015, and the years show as poise: top shelf on the whole ledger, with a trigger that runs warm and a game that sharpens as the bar rises. The aim is above average, the headshots land, and the lifetime numbers match the matchups. That is a strong regular, plain and simple.

fxgxgr.text: FXGXGR is the matchup board's quiet surprise: top shelf in the sampled fights, with resistance few can match and a kept share that stays firm as the stakes rise. The trigger runs at a good clip, yet the lifetime IvI reads middling and the aim is ordinary. The matchups hold the truer story here.

fireatomwall2.text: FireAtomWall2 has been around since 2018, and it shows: a steady output, staying power as the opposition improves, and a grade that sits top-shelf. The aim sits near the top, though the headshots are only middling. The lifetime IvI lands above average, a notch below the matchups.

friedicecream.text: FriedIcecream has been at this since 2018, and the years show: a top-shelf rating, with the most precise aim tracked and a high share of headshots. The work rate is relentless and the game keeps its shape as the enemies get tougher. Lifetime board backs up the matchups, end of story.

fussybaby.text: FussyBaby is a young account, big-game feel and all: a furious output, a game that never fades as the enemies get tougher, and a mark that sits top-shelf. Aim is precise, and headshots make up a high share of the shots. Early read, but the first pages already carry weight.

failswoop.text: Failswoop brings the complete package: top shelf in the matchups, swift, and solid as foes get stronger. The aim sits near the top, the headshots land close behind, and the pace always stays high. Career numbers and matchups line up neatly, no daylight between them.

fearandtrembling.text: fearandtrembling is the model of a complete game: top shelf in the matchups, brisk, and unfazed as foes get stronger. Aim is true with headshots close behind, and the tempo holds steady throughout. The career numbers match the matchups, which keeps the whole story straight.

faalswoop.text: Faalswoop hunts at full speed: the tempo is relentless, the courage holds against stronger enemies, the staying power holds, and the paired-fight kill-death record sits near the top. The aim is sharp, headshots land above average, with the lifetime board putting the career near the summit. Consistency rests mid-pack — the only quiet line on a loud card.

feirmily.text: feirmily wins ugly and wins often: the adjusted rating heads the card, the tempo keeps coming, the staying power matches, and the duel-scored kill-death line sits in the same tier. Accuracy sits below average, headshots land rarely, and the lifetime IvI sinks near the bottom — the lifetime board badly undersells this game. Consistency sags below average, but the results in real matchups speak plainly enough.

flarezest.text: Flarezest burns bright on every line: the adjusted rating runs high, the pace never drops, the nerve holds, the staying power stays firm. The matchup kill-death mark walks alongside. The output is relentless, the aim runs true, and headshots land with pleasing regularity. The lifetime board seconds that, rating the career among the top ranks, and consistency rests mid-pack.

foxyhahnderalkoholiker.text: FoxyHahnDerAlkoholiker plays at a sprint from first contact: a furious work rate, bravery that rises with the opposition, and accuracy near the top. The consistency mark slips below average, the single flaw in an otherwise relentless card, and the lifetime IvI lands above average. A whirlwind who rarely lets a fight cool down.

falcofr.text: FalcoFR is a young account with an old soul: tempo and bravery both in the upper tier, resistance right there. The matchup kill-death mark crowds the top. Accuracy runs top-shelf; the lifetime IvI already sits in the upper tier. Consistency sits below average, so the edge still has to prove itself against the strongest third — early days, but the first pages promise plenty.

fistenjoyer.text: FistEnjoyer keeps the engine running hot: the matchup rating rides near the top, the tempo matches it, and the game never wilts against tougher enemies, with a kill-death mark up there as well. The tempo runs above average, accuracy sits well above average. Lifetime numbers agree, sitting in the same strong range. A steady, high-volume presence with no quiet stretches.

foxycatortr.text: FoxycatorTR brings the noise: one of the busiest outputs tracked, a matchup rating near the top, with a game that climbs as enemies improve close behind. Matchup kill-death sits there too, and the lifetime board runs a step below the matchups. Headshots run middle of the road, which only makes the volume more impressive.

feiixow.text: FeIixOW is the complete package: bravery among the very best tracked, matchup rating and activity near the top, and resistance holding near the top. The aim is sharp, headshots keep landing near the top, and the consistency mark sits near the top too. Even the lifetime board, which usually flatters or undersells, lands near the top here.

flanna.text: Flanna has been at this since 2013, and it shows: matchup rating near the top, resistance holding near the top, and a matchup kill-death mark near the top. The aim is sharp, though headshots land below average, and the lifetime board rates them mid-pack, well below the matchups. The edge fades against the strongest third, the one soft spot on a long, strong card.

fr0stwo1f.text: fr0stWo1f arrived in 2026 and already plays top-shelf: rating near the top across the board, with kills coming at a top rate. Sharp aim, headshots landing near the top, and lifetime numbers right up there too. Consistency runs below average, the lone wrinkle on a fast-starting card.

fan220.text: Fan220 has played since 2017 and the card reads like a showcase: rating, activity, and bravery all at the very top; resistance and kill-death figures trail close. Accuracy and headshots sit near the top too, so the shots land clean. Consistency alone sits mid-pack, while lifetime numbers rank them among the best — a veteran at the peak.

ferdighost.text: FerdiGhost is a ghost in the best sense: the full spread — rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — all hold near the summit, and the head-on kill-death count keeps pace. Accuracy sits well above average, headshots near the very top, and the lifetime IvI runs a touch above the matchups. Consistency holds well above average too, which leaves this card with barely a blemish.

fleshtradiolncw.text: FleshtradiolNCW is a young account off to a flying start: activity and bravery both near the top, resistance close behind, with output near the very top. Accuracy sits near the top and the consistency mark well above average, so the edge holds against the strongest third. Early read, but the first impression is already loud.

flowsyyyy.text: Flowsyyyy is a young account already competing at the very top: rating, activity, bravery, resistance all crowd near the summit. Accuracy sits near the top, while the lifetime board holds them near the top too. Early read, but the first pages already carry real weight.

fineroadrunner.text: FineRoadrunner runs on volume and nerve: rating, activity, and resistance near the top, with matchup and lifetime kill-death marks to match. The aim sits below average and headshots are rare, yet the kills keep coming — the lifetime IvI near the bottom says the lifetime board never saw it. Consistency dips below average, the only crack in a fast, fearless game.

falcofrnc.text: FalcoFRNC is barely a month old and already flying: pace at the very top, a game that sharpens with the opposition, and accuracy near the very top. Headshots land often, the lifetime IvI sits among the best, and the guard holds steady. Early read, but the opening pages already carry weight.

flowowo.text: Flowowo flows through fights like water: brisk output, a game that lifts as the opposition improves, and accuracy near the very top. Headshots land often, the consistency mark sits well above average, and the lifetime record sits among the best. A young account with an old head — the first chapter already reads strong.

ferrarimolli.text: FerrariMOlli plays a polished power game: rating, bravery, and resistance all top-tier, with matchup kill-death figures to match. The aim stays well above average while headshots land at a middling rate, so the kills come from steady pressure. The lifetime board sits a notch below the matchups, but the shape holds.

fleshtradiolvsw.text: FleshtradiolVSW has barely arrived and already plays like a storm: the matchup rating, tempo, and bravery all clear the upper tier; the duel kill-death count sits near the very best. Shots land clean and often, and the pace never lets up. Against the hardest third the edge thins out, the one wrinkle in a young account's opening chapter — early read, but the first pages crackle.

fonftwaf.text: fonftwaf brings a sharp edge to every fight: upper tier on the matchup board, with staying power against quick-killing opposition and a direct-fight kill-death record near the top. The accuracy lands near the top too, the headshot share mid-pack, and the lifetime board trails the matchups by a step. The wrinkle: when the fights get hardest, the edge thins a little.

flamedragonarmor.text: FlameDragonArmor plays at a sprint: top-tier in the matchups, relentless in tempo, and bravery that holds as the field hardens. The faceoff kill-death count rides near the top. The lifetime board backs it up. Facing the sternest third, the edge thins out sharply, the single soft patch on a fierce card — when the field is even, few keep up.

furongwangtrc.text: FuRongWangTRC plays a pressing game: top of the matchup board, with fast hands, and composed under fire. The edge thins sharply against the hardest opposition, and the lifetime board tells a plainer story. No banner moment, just a player who turns up and gets the job done.

furrygf.text: FurryGF plays the quiet game: upper tier in the matchups, unhurried on the trigger, and composed when the stakes climb. Nothing flashy, nothing fragile — just a measured game where the matchups outshine the lifetime board. The lifetime numbers sit a notch below, which keeps the story honest: a strong regular with a steady hand.

forthelord.text: FORTHELORD charges in and the numbers charge with them: a top-tier rating, a blistering tempo, and bravery that keeps climbing as fights get harder. The aim runs comfortably above average, and the lifetime ledger sits above average too. Facing the toughest third, the edge dips a little — barely a footnote on a fast, fearless record.

flowerbox.text: FlowerBOX brings a heavyweight card: matchup rating top-tier, duel record to match, and a lifetime kill-death line that sits just as high. The one crack: against the strongest third, the edge thins badly — consistency near the bottom while everything else shines. A veteran whose best fights are the ones that matter, and whose worst come against the very best.

flash247.text: Flash247 has been turning up since 2013, and the card still reads strong: a clear cut above average on the matchup ledger, with resistance near the top. The pace runs above average, headshots land a notch above average, and the aim sits ordinary. At the sharp end, the edge dips below average — the one wrinkle on a long, solid record.

fb1openup.text: FB1OpenUp brings a balanced, hard-working game: well above average across the matchup card, unshaken as the opposition toughens, and sharp where it counts. The headshot share sits near the top while the raw accuracy stays middling — precision in the finishes, not the volume. The lifetime board is kinder still, rating the whole run a notch above the matchups.

fumaporros69.text: Fumaporros69 shoots like few others tracked: accuracy and headshot share both sit near the summit, and the lifetime board agrees the whole picture is elite. Matchup rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — all four run well above average. Only the consistency line dips below average, so the edge softens a little when the opposition is at its strongest.

fireshadowai.text: FIRESHADOWAI plays a steady, unspectacular game: well above average on the matchup board, composed as the opposition hardens, and even across the card. The matchup kill-death line sits in the middle, the one line trailing the rest. The aim, the headshots, and the lifetime board all sit mid-pack too — a reliable regular, no more and no less.

frekenbook.text: FrekenBook has played since 2014 and still picks the fights well: the matchup lines all sit well above average, and a lifetime kill-death tally near the top. The headshot share sits above average, and the lifetime numbers line up with the matchups. The pace and the aim sit mid-pack, and the edge holds its own as the opposition toughens — a veteran card built on judgment.

foxbosss.text: FOXBOSSS is the strangest card in the pile: a lifetime kill-death line near the very top, built on a slow pace and a wandering aim. Accuracy sits below average, headshots near the bottom, and the lifetime IvI follows them down. Yet the matchup kill-death line holds near the top — results that refuse to fit the usual mould.

frelbler.text: FRElBlER never eases off: activity near the top, bravery to match, and a kill pace that never relents. The matchup rating shows well above average, the aim is sharp, and headshots land where they count. The one soft spot: the toughest-third line sinks below average, the lone line that will not keep up.

fovbaiter.text: FOVBaiter hits hard and fast: activity and bravery both at the summit, a kill pace keeping step, and accuracy and headshots among the finest tracked. The matchup rating stands well clear of the middle, resistance stays firm, and the lifetime board lands near the top. Consistency holds in the middle — the one average line on a loud card.

fragkitt3n.text: FragKitt3n is a fresh name on the board and already loud: a matchup K/D line near the top, resistance near the top, with the lifetime kill-death line right behind it. Yet the accuracy sits near the bottom and the headshot share runs low, so the lifetime IvI line trails far behind. Early read, but the opening is impossible to ignore.
